articles.title: Company Overview
articles.markdown:
# Company

**Cobalt Home** sells connected entry devices and cloud subscriptions. Support handles devices, apps, LTE, billing, orders, and warranty.

articles.title: Warranty Policy
articles.markdown:
# Warranty

Shopify purchases get a limited hardware warranty from delivery date. Amazon purchases must use Amazon returns/A-to-Z for the original buy; we can still diagnose devices. Out of warranty: 15-25% replacement coupon — never free lifetime replacement.

articles.title: Returns Policy
articles.markdown:
# Returns

Shopify orders may get a prepaid RMA when eligible. Amazon orders return only through Amazon.
